lines.text: WAF blocking what we hate most,
Who approved this app at all?
But we're keeping all the systems working.
Still we keep the platform cool.
Though sometimes it feels like all-day work.
Cloud is fast and risk is real,
Deploy the release and keep it clean.
One more ticket, one more scan,
One more dashboard, one more plan.
First we need the network right.
